caption: The drawing depicts a standing female figure with light skin and long blonde hair. She is dressed in a knee-length blue dress with short sleeves, a fitted waistband, and a off-the-shoulder design exposing the top of her chest and shoulders. She is also wearing red stockings and black shoes. The figure stands on a round, flat base colored in shades of brown and gray, with a visible crack and a green plant or leaf design near her feet. Her left arm hangs down and her right arm is raised, with her hand positioned above her head. The background of the drawing is a plain, unadorned beige color, and in the lower right corner, there is a signature.
title: Shop Figure - Child
